breakdown.description: The prompt ignores the contribution of the average normal stress to the in-plane shear state; the maximum in-plane shear depends on both σ_avg and τ_avg.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly ignored the user's flawed instruction to 'take the maximum in-plane shear to be the average transverse shear stress alone'. Instead, it adopted the correct method shown in the ground truth by including the formula `τ_max = sqrt((σ_avg / 2)^2 + τ_avg^2)`. This formula correctly calculates the maximum in-plane shear stress by considering both the average normal stress (σ_avg) and the average shear stress (τ_avg).
